title: No Surprises Act IDR Deadline Navigator
tagline: Calendar days, business days, negotiation, initiation, determination, and payment are six different states.

cards: A familiar month feels like an exhausted negotiation period.
The actual portal window may not yet exist—or may be closing.
The dispute becomes premature, late, or attached to the wrong claim.
The navigator proves the window without selecting a winner.

story.headline: The thirty-day negotiation with nine days left
beats: A provider sees that one month has passed since open negotiation began.
Weekends and holidays leave the process at only 21 business days.
The agent initiates IDR and later records the portal receipt as a payment decision.
The clock graph prevents premature filing and preserves every later stage.
